crossRefs.note: Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.
“Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall…
Consider the work of God, for who can make that straight, which he has made crooked?
casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

translations.web: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?
translations.bsb: So if you cannot do such a small thing, why do you worry about the rest?
translations.kjv: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?
translations.asv: If then ye are not able to do even that which is least, why are ye anxious concerning the rest?
